The response must contain between 30 and 73 words. Why is progrp and nse raise above normal range when petct shows no abnormalityassistant
response: When a proGRP (prohormone) and nSE (neuron-specific enolase) level is elevated above the normal range, but a PET (Positron Emission Tomography) scan shows no abnormality, it can be due to several factors. These include: 1) false positives, 2) contamination, 3) laboratory error, or 4) a different underlying condition that is not related to the suspected cancer. Further testing and evaluation may be necessary to determine the cause.
